18153387640.description: ADVANCED INTENSITY - Join iFIT Trainer Evan Dollard in Austria at Krimml Waterfalls—Europe’s largest waterfall and the fifth largest in the world. You’ll start at the bottom of the three-tiered falls, then climb your way up to the top tier, alternating between a speed walk and leisurely stroll. It’s a steep climb, but the breathtaking views will be worth it!

18153230482.description: ADVANCED INTENSITY - Start at the base of the beautiful Dachstein Mountains, then hike your way up to a quaint mountain hut known as Sudwandhutte. It’s a short workout that maintains a steady tempo throughout. With iFIT trainer Evan Dollard leading the way, you’ll pass mountain goats, a waterfall, and cross over patches of snow.

18155967852.description: ADVANCED INTENSITY - Cruise up the Kitzlochklamm Gorge with iFIT Trainer Evan Dollard. Located in the stunning Austrian Alps, this fast-paced workout takes you for a power walk down an alpine-tree-lined path, then up the gorge over several beautiful bridges. It’s high-intensity with varying inclines and little recovery.

18155465592.description: ADVANCED INTENSITY - Join iFIT Trainer Evan Dollard for a steep, power-hiking interval workout in the Dachstein Nature Reserve. With an equal work to rest ratio, you’ll start at the halfway point up to Simony Hut, then climb your way to the peak for incredible views of Dachstein Glacier.

18154976980.description: ADVANCED INTENSITY - Hike up to Simony Hut in the Dachstein Nature Reserve. With iFIT Trainer Evan Dollard, you’ll focus on maintaining the same effort level the entire time, despite the changing speeds and inclines. As you cross the rugged terrain, enjoy the beautiful snow-capped mountain views in the distance!

18154473705.description: ADVANCED INTENSITY - Join iFIT Trainer Evan Dollard in Austria at Wildes Wasser, also known as Wild Water. You’ll start off on a staired mountain trail, then break off onto a dirt path to hike along the mountainside above a waterfall. This is a steep summit workout focusing on maintaining a high-intensity tempo the entire time.

18154140330.description: ADVANCED INTENSITY - This workout alternates between 30- and 60-second intervals as you climb your way up to a remote mountain hut in the Dolomites. You’ll switch between a power walk and a leisurely pace the entire time, then finish with a short stretch to help loosen up your muscles.

18153812628.description: ADVANCED INTENSITY - Climb the incredible Dolomites on a beautiful, sunny day in northeastern Italy. iFIT Trainer Evan Dollard will lead you through a steady, high-tempo hike up Laserzbach Trail. With varying inclines throughout, you’ll strive to keep your pace and effort level the same throughout the entire workout.

18153548954.description: ADVANCED INTENSITY - Head to the beautiful town of Salzburg, Austria—home to the birthplace of famous 18th-century composer, Mozart. You’ll join iFIT Trainer Evan Dollard for a quick power-walking workout up Kapuzinerberg Hill, where you’ll climb to the top and finish with a stunning view of the city at the end.

18168804845.description: Join iFIT Trainer Sally McRae in Part 1 of the Grand Circle Trailfest! In this 1st segment of Trailfest: Bryce Canyon, you’ll keep a steady pace as you race up and down hills. Taking in the breathtaking views while you work hard and have fun!

18168042907.description: ADVANCED INTENSITY - Adventure through the dense Austrian forest with iFIT Trainer Evan Dollard. This workout is high-intensity and fast-paced the whole way through, as you’ll be climbing up a steep mountain for nearly 40 minutes straight. There won’t be any rest breaks, but there will be incredible views of cascading waterfalls and fields of wildflowers.

18167603725.description: ADVANCED INTENSITY- iFIT Trainer Evan Dollard will take you to Schafberg Mountain in Upper Austria for some advanced, power-walking intervals. This workout is designed to help you burn serious calories, while keeping the impact nice and low on your joints as you hike to the top. Be sure to push yourself up the inclines and take in all the luscious, green beauty of the Austrian countryside.

18167156556.description: ADVANCED INTENSITY - iFIT Trainer Evan Dollard will lead you on a steep hike up Mount Schoberstein in the Höllengebirge mountain range, also known as the mountains of hell. The climb to the top will be worth it as you enjoy incredible views of Austria’s third largest lake—Lake Attersee.

18307520391.description: In this 20-minute run, you’ll focus on building your endurance with iFIT Trainer Tommy Rivs. As you run, enjoy views of the North Coast while Rivs shares fun facts about the island.

18544800592.description: Incline is the name of the game in this workout! You’ll work through lots of different moves as you make your way up to Martial Glacier, climbing above the treeline in southern Argentina with iFIT Trainer Chris Clark.

18544264470.description: Head back to the mountains to crush some intervals with iFIT Trainer John Peel. You’ll do 20 rounds, alternating between one minute of running and one minute of speed walking. Once you reach the peak, you’ll hop off your machine and finish with a 6-minute core circuit.
